overall_critique: Exceptional production quality with precise Remotion motion graphics and broadcast-grade UI styling. The top progress bar and HUD data cards establish instant authority, while the 8-exercise split is dynamically paced for high TikTok and Reels algorithmic completion rates. Typography, layout consistency, and anatomy-focused tagging give the montage an elite aesthetic.

safe_zone_audit.top_safe_zone: Pass. The dual header capsules ('HAMZAWY // 4K MASTER' and 'EXERCISE X / 8') sit comfortably around 6-8% vertical margin, safely clearing notch bezels, island cutouts, and platform status bars. The slim top energy gradient bar provides clear visual progress without obstructing system UI.
safe_zone_audit.right_action_zone: Pass. Text containers and telemetry cards terminate with comfortable horizontal margin padding, ensuring zero overlap with TikTok's right-side engagement column (like, comment, bookmark, share buttons).
safe_zone_audit.bottom_caption_zone: Pass. The lower exercise info card and real-time rep progression bar are positioned at approximately 75-82% viewport height, keeping all key typography safely elevated above TikTok sound metadata, captions, and profile handles.

color_and_lighting_audit.skin_tone_naturalness: 9.4/10 - Warm, authentic skin tones across varied gym ambient lighting. Highlights maintain realistic roll-off without unnatural clipping or hyper-saturated orange shifts.
color_and_lighting_audit.color_balance: 9.3/10 - High-contrast balance between dark gym machinery, neutral wall paint, and the punchy high-vis orange/cyan accents of the HUD. Black levels are grounded and clean.
color_and_lighting_audit.distraction_free: 9.1/10 - Excellent graphical stability. Smooth dip-to-action transition pacing between exercises avoids jarring strobe cuts while keeping visual momentum steady.
